message:
When Grandma calls instead of clicking her RSVP link, record her reply yourself. It's saved just like one from the form.

Bridal Team's free guest list gives every household its own private RSVP link. Guests accept or decline, name everyone coming, pick a dish and note allergies, and you see who's coming and who you're still waiting on.

Try it free: https://bridalteam.com/wedding-rsvp?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-10-noon-rsvp-by-phone
